title: Export Records inside Loop
description: Performance rule — Export Records inside a Loop writes a file on every iteration.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Exporting per iteration multiplies disk I/O and can overwrite the same file repeatedly.
rule.remediation: Export once after the loop, gathering the data into a single found set first.
